说明: 工具参数参考。以客户端 tools/list 为准。

tools.name: spine_doctor
tools.title: Check Spine setup
tools.description: Checks the Spine CLI, editor version and license, spine-core version and work folder. Run first when something fails.

tools.name: spine_project_info
tools.title: Spine project info
tools.description: Fast CLI summary (`Spine -i`): editor version, FPS, skeletons, bone/slot/constraint/animation lists. Several paths per call (one ~3 s CLI start).

tools.name: spine_export_json
tools.title: Export project to JSON
tools.description: Exports a .spine project's skeletons to JSON in the cache folder (never next to the project); re-exports only when the project changed.

tools.name: spine_inspect
tools.title: Inspect skeleton
tools.description: Skeleton structure. view summary (default): counts, bone tree, constraints, per-animation stats; bones|slots|skins|constraints: raw section JSON; animation: every timeline with exact keys.

tools.name: spine_validate
tools.title: Validate skeleton
tools.description: Finds problems: duplicate names, bone order, missing references (Spine drops them on import), mesh indices, key order, curves, keys on physics bones; samples every animation in spine-core (NaN, loop seams, clamps, invisible keys, mesh folds, joints opening). face: blinks vs pose changes and mouth swaps, lashes while shut, mouth bones, blink timing.

eyes.description: Eye slots: shut while hidden or on a `closed` attachment

blink.description: Blink played on a track above

mouthGroups.description: Bones of one mouth drawing: at setup while another is shown

fps.description: For frame counts (default: skeleton fps or 30)

faces.description: Several faces, one audit each: {name, + lids…mouthGroups as above}

tools.name: spine_measure
tools.title: Measure animation motion
tools.description: Samples an animation in spine-core (constraints, physics warmed up); per bone: rotation range, path, peak speeds, pops, holds, loop seam. rootMotion: what SkeletonRootMotion reads (travel, sliding feet, in-place speed). parts: how far each slot travels.

tools.name: spine_timing
tools.title: Animation timing report
tools.description: Timing structure from the keys: key poses and intervals, segment durations, ease type per segment, holds.

tools.name: spine_compare_animations
tools.title: Compare two animations
tools.description: A/B of two animations of one skeleton: duration, motion ratio, per-bone changes (biggest first), timing structure; optional contact sheets.

tools.name: spine_render_frames
tools.title: Render animation frames
tools.description: Renders an animation with Spine's renderer (~4 s, cached) and returns a contact sheet. No MSAA or physics warm-up: for checking, not final video.

tools.name: spine_add_animation
tools.title: Add animation to project
tools.description: Adds one Spine 4.3 JSON animation to a .spine project. Dry-run validates against the skeleton; apply backs up, imports only this animation through the CLI, re-exports, verifies and rolls back on any mismatch. Existing names need replace; prefer a new name. Times in seconds; rotate uses `value`; bezier `curve` is absolute [cx1,cy1,cx2,cy2] per channel.

tools.name: spine_derive_animation
tools.title: Derive animation variant
tools.description: Builds a new animation from an existing one with ops applied in order on the server, then adds it like spine_add_animation (validated, backed up, verified; dry-run unless apply). Ops: docs/USAGE.md#derive-operations.

easing.description: linear, stepped, ease, easeIn|Out|InOut[Sine|Cubic], easeOutBack, easeInBack, cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2)

pairs.description: Default: from names; [] = every bone in place

tools.name: spine_generate_animation
tools.title: Generate animation from the rig
tools.description: Generate a named animation draft. Fill the object matching type; missing controls return suggestions. Dry-run by default; apply uses verified CLI animation import and backup. Types include breathe, blink, gaze, lookAt, sway, settle, followThrough, walk, blocking, turn, squash, lipSync. Seconds/degrees/skeleton units. See docs/USAGE.md#generate-options.

open.description: "" when the slot is empty while open (a lid drawn over the eye)

source.description: Or a driving animation, with bone

view.description: front: faces the camera, marches in place

tools.name: spine_import_layers
tools.title: PSD layers to a new Spine project
tools.description: New Spine project from a layered PSD: a region per layer at its canvas position, draw order from layer order, bones from groups (or PhotoshopToSpine tags), images next to it; masks baked, unsupported effects reported. Or json: PhotoshopToSpine's output (checked). Or parts: PNGs placed by a layout JSON (See-through, cut-boxes or {parts:[{file,x,y|bbox|center,order,bone,pivot,slot}]}). Dry-run by default, never overwrites; verified by re-export and a render against the PSD or the placed parts. Places art only.

layout.description: Default: layout.json or parts.json in parts or its parent

targetHeight.description: Shown height in px: flags oversized art

tools.name: spine_auto_rig
tools.title: Rig a layered PSD into a new Spine project
tools.description: Starting rig in a new project from a layered PSD or parts + layout: bones at joints, traced meshes, weights, optional two-bone IK; hidden lids rigged shut-collapsed. Without bones: suggests a skeleton over the art (nothing written; riders: one character sits on another; rigFrom: an approved rig's joints); pass back as bones. With bones: dry-run with checks; apply writes, validates, runs rig QA, renders test poses. Never overwrites.

targetHeight.description: Shown height in px: flags oversized art

tools.name: spine_update_images
tools.title: Bring new PSD art into an existing project
tools.description: Updates a project's image files from a layered PSD without touching the .spine: layers matched to images and cut to their frames, so meshes and animations stay valid. placement psd takes the PSD's layout; grow enlarges a region image. Dry-run with before/after renders; apply backs up and writes. restore: a backup id.

tools.name: spine_rig_edit
tools.title: Rig edits into a new project
tools.description: Adds bones, IK, physics, events and skins, sets setup poses, removes constraints, traces regions into meshes in place (meshRegion), copies meshes from another rig (copyMesh); written to a NEW .spine via JSON import (original untouched), listing what else the round trip changed. Dry-run by default; one skeleton.

tools.name: spine_list_backups
tools.title: List project backups
tools.description: Backups made before writes (newest first), ids for spine_restore_backup.

tools.name: spine_restore_backup
tools.title: Restore project backup
tools.description: Puts a backup back. Dry-run by default; apply backs up the current file first, then restores atomically.

tools.name: spine_transfer_animation
tools.title: Transfer an animation to another skeleton
tools.description: Copies an animation to another skeleton or project, matching names (exact, map, then case/separator-insensitive); reports what matched, renamed or could not move, then adds it like spine_add_animation (dry-run by default). copies: merge mode for animators on copies of one project: what each copy added or changed, conflicts (resolve with prefer), then writes into the base (to).

retarget.description: Scale translate keys to the target

tools.name: spine_edit_animation
tools.title: Copy and edit animation keyframes
tools.description: Copies source to name, edits timelines in order, then uses backed-up CLI import and readback verification. Dry-run by default. edits:[] duplicates. path is JSON segments, e.g. ['bones','head','rotate']; times are seconds. set replaces whole keys at matching times. easing is normalized; raw key.curve is absolute Spine 4.3. See docs/USAGE.md#keyframe-editing.

tools.name: spine_export
tools.title: Export runtime files
tools.description: Exports runtime files (JSON and/or .skel plus a packed atlas, optional scales), verified with spine-core in a temp folder before copying to outputDir (no overwrite unless set; project untouched, ~3-5 s). Reports page fill and texture memory. sweep: ranks atlas settings by texture memory and pages, writing nothing.

preset.description: mobile/desktop: binary, PMA, 2048/4096; web: JSON, PMA, 2048

editorVersion.description: Data format editor: "project" or e.g. "4.2.43" (default pinned)

tools.name: spine_showcase
tools.title: Make a showcase animation
tools.description: 1-4 animations rendered by Spine side by side, labelled, as an animated .webp (alpha), .gif or .mp4 written only to output. For before/after and reels. Needs ImageMagick plus img2webp or ffmpeg.

tools.name: spine_unity_check
tools.title: Check the export in Unity
tools.description: Fresh export into a throwaway Unity project, every animation vs spine-core bone by bone (~30 s); perf: CPU/GC per skeleton. Options: docs/USAGE.md#into-your-unity-project.

spineUnity.description: Commit, or a Unity project's lock

tools.name: spine_review_video
tools.title: Review video
tools.description: Review cut MP4: each animation rendered by Spine at each speed, every frame labelled (animation, speed, frame, time); optional audio under real-time passes and a title card. Writes only output.

tools.name: spine_motion_visual
tools.title: Onion skin, arcs and curves
tools.description: Onion skin, bone arcs (one dot per frame) and value curves of one animation as an image, plus the numbers. Bones default to the 3 that travel furthest.

tools.name: spine_reference_timing
tools.title: Timing from a reference video
tools.description: Timing from a reference video (optional crop): motion peaks, holds, cuts and repeat period as a frame table, graph and sheet. compare aligns a Spine animation on the peaks (speed ratio, offset, per-peak frames).

tools.name: spine_video_inspect
tools.title: Inspect a video frame by frame
tools.description: Frame-by-frame video check: encoding (VFR, size, pixel format, audio), segments at cuts and transitions with hold pattern (ones/twos), flashes, stutters, dropped frames, motion peaks, audio onsets vs cuts/peaks; an event list, per-frame curves and an overview sheet. verify compares a segment with a Spine animation. Exact frames: spine_video_frames.

tools.name: spine_video_frames
tools.title: Exact video frames
tools.description: Exact video frames by number (spine_video_inspect's numbering) as a labelled sheet; diff marks changes in red, onion blends them. Up to 48 per call.

tools.name: spine_unity_import
tools.title: Import into a Unity project
tools.description: Imports a .spine into a Unity project with spine-unity (data, atlas, materials, mixes, prefab), then compares it bone by bone with spine-core; reports texture settings and render pipeline. Dry-run by default. update: replace in place (backed up, GUIDs kept). With Unity open, only files are copied. audit: read-only scan (version, data files, API changes).

tools.name: spine_web_check
tools.title: Check the export on the web runtime
tools.description: Renders a fresh export with spine-webgl in headless Chrome and compares every frame with Spine's render (silhouette IoU, colour difference, worst frame). Needs Chrome or CHROME_BIN.

tools.name: spine_mix_check
tools.title: Check animation transitions for pops
tools.description: Plays transitions with spine-core's AnimationState like a game (mixes, optional base track), switching at several points; reports pops with phase and likely cause, timelines first keyed after 0, and events lost inside the mix. runtime mecanim: as spine-unity's SkeletonMecanim, plus the keys each incoming animation needs (setupKeys).

transitions.description: Default: every pair, up to limit

tools.name: spine_budget
tools.title: Performance budget
tools.description: Spine Metrics over the setup pose and every frame: attachments, vertices, vertex transforms, triangles, area, clipping, draw call estimate, timelines, constraint costs; worst values with animation@time. limits for pass/fail; draw calls need atlas or pack (~4 s).

tools.name: spine_snapshot
tools.title: Snapshot a project
tools.description: Saves a labelled, verified backup copy before risky editor work (compare later with spine_reimport_diff). Without label: lists snapshots.

tools.name: spine_reimport_diff
tools.title: What a re-import changed
tools.description: Compares a project with a snapshot (default latest) or another .spine/.json: what broke (lost keys, weights, meshes, removed items) and what changed, then where playback of common animations now differs.

tools.name: spine_editor_status
tools.title: Spine editor status and import check
tools.description: Is a Spine editor window open (and likely on this project)? While it is, writes go to a verified staging copy. With project: what still waits in the staging copy; animations confirms each one after Import Project and a save.

tools.name: spine_status
tools.title: Project status and recent spine-mcp steps
tools.description: Instant, no CLI: file state, editor window, staging copy, backups, spine-mcp's last steps on the project and outside changes since. Call first when resuming work.

tools.name: spine_rig_qa
tools.title: Rig QA
tools.description: Rig hygiene: names (spaces, clashes, default names, mixed left/right styles), unused bones, attachments, slots and events, bad setup scale, weights not summing to 1, too many influences, weights that fold when a bone turns, joints that open, art a mesh cuts off, missing or unused images. Complements spine_validate.

tools.name: spine_skins
tools.title: Skin and skin combination check
tools.description: Checks each skin, or mix-and-match combinations: attachment counts, slots several skins set (last wins), slots none fills, and each one's budget over every frame. atlas or pack for exact draw calls.

tools.name: spine_audit
tools.title: Audit a folder of Spine projects
tools.description: Validate, rig QA and budget on every .spine and skeleton .json under a folder: one ok/fail row per skeleton (strict: validation warnings fail too). For release checks and CI.
